category_edits.rationale: Test a mild causal prefix-length feature across all four datasets: amplify real history inputs by up to 3% as observed context grows. Padding remains zero and candidate embeddings remain unchanged. The embedded predictor imports the modified model; matching metadata validation ensures consistent inference without changing learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss, or optimizer.

edits.replace:
def _interest_states(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.item_emb(seq)
        real_inputs = seq.ne(0)
        prefix_count = real_inputs.cumsum(dim=1).clamp(max=20).to(emb.dtype)
        input_scale = 1.0 + 0.03 * prefix_count / 20.0
        emb = self.dropout(emb * input_scale.unsqueeze(-1))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)

change_summary: Add bounded causal prefix-length scaling exclusively to history input embeddings, with synchronized checkpoint metadata and embedded predictor validation. Retain one GRU4Rec model per category and existing training settings.
